Cysteine-free, with balanced acidic/basic side chains.","expected_discrimination":"Seek simultaneous Y39/S42 contacts across MSA, where their Cα separation is 5.7–5.8 Å, versus 8.4 Å in 8A9L and 7.5 Å in 6CU7; sequence alone does not establish selectivity."},{"sequence":"SQYNPATQDSKN","hypothesis":"Shape-led test: NPAT turn candidate positions an aromatic anchor and polar arm without a hydrophobic cluster.","expected_discrimination":"Target the MSA 40–42 separation of 5.4 Å rather than 6.8/7.1 Å in 8A9L/6CU7; require additional K43/T44 contacts to support the pose."},{"sequence":"KQYSPNDTQESK","hypothesis":"Shape-led revision of KQYSEGNDTQESK, whose contrast was −1.077: replace EG with PN to test whether reduced linker flexibility improves worst-conformer compatibility.","expected_discrimination":"Test a bend spanning Y39–S42, compact in all MSA conformers but wider in both controls; avoid interpreting the original single-conformer contacts as success."},{"sequence":"QNYTPAQSDTKNSQ","hypothesis":"Shape-led test: TPA bend with one Tyr anchor and soluble polar flanks; assess whether modest preorganization avoids assembly clashes.","expected_discrimination":"MSA L38–S42 distances are 9.3–9.4 Å, versus 12.2 Å in 8A9L and 4.5 Å in 6CU7, providing opposing geometric mismatches."},{"sequence":"SQTYPNSAQDTKNSQETG","hypothesis":"Shape-led longer alternative: a localized YPN bend with polar extensions, rather than a uniformly flexible aromatic-acidic linker.","expected_discrimination":"Seek the shared MSA L38–G41 span of 9.5–9.8 Å; 6CU7 is sharply folded at 4.4 Å, while rejecting 8A9L additionally requires its wider Y39–S42 geometry."},{"sequence":"QYPNQDTNSK","hypothesis":"Charge-led test: a single Asp near a constrained aromatic/polar motif, reducing nonspecific electrostatic attraction relative to multi-acidic designs.","expected_discrimination":"K43 alone is insufficient because it is more exposed in 8A9L; require MSA-like Y39–S42 geometry and accessible T44, whose SASA is only 9.0 Å² in 6CU7."},{"sequence":"KQYPNETQNSK","hypothesis":"Charge-led matched alternative: substitute a longer Glu side chain for an Asp-type anchor while keeping a compact YPN motif and avoiding net acidic excess.","expected_discrimination":"Test K43 anchoring only when coupled to the MSA Y39–S42 separation of 5.7–5.8 Å; both controls have wider separations."},{"sequence":"QSYPAQDTNQSK","hypothesis":"Charge-led test: one localized Asp and one Lys with a Pro/Ala spacer; prioritizes spatially gated K43 recognition over broad acidity.","expected_discrimination":"MSA Y39–K43 spans 8.3–8.7 Å versus 9.5 Å in 8A9L and 10.5 Å in 6CU7; side-chain placement must be verified by prediction."},{"sequence":"KNSYQPNATDQSKNTQG","hypothesis":"Charge-led revision of KNSYQEGTNDQSKETNQG, the least-negative first-round contrast (−0.722): reduce acidic density and introduce one turn constraint.","expected_discrimination":"The parent had only 0.222 contacts/residue in 6XYO; seek improved three-MSA coverage through Y39/S42/K43 anchoring, not merely retained 6XYQ contacts."},{"sequence":"SQYAPNQTKSDNQATKQSNT","hypothesis":"Charge-led long alternative: isolated Asp within a mildly basic, polar scaffold; tests whether distributed polar support can replace multiple acidic contacts.","expected_discrimination":"Require compact MSA L38–S42 geometry plus T44 engagement; 8A9L is more extended and 6CU7 combines a compressed 38–42 span with poorly exposed T44."},{"sequence":"QNYSTNQATK","hypothesis":"Polar-led test: acid-free Tyr/Ser/Thr/Asn motif to probe hydrogen-bond anchoring without a K43 salt bridge; hydrophobicity is limited to one Tyr.","expected_discrimination":"Target joint Y39/S42/T44 recognition; 8A9L has a wider Y39–S42 span, while 6CU7 offers substantially less T44 exposure."},{"sequence":"QHNYSPTQNAK","hypothesis":"Polar-led revision of QHNSYTGQEDTK: retain His/Tyr but remove both acidic residues and replace the flexible TG segment with a Pro-containing motif.","expected_discrimination":"The parent contrast was −2.916 with strong 8A9L contacts; test whether geometry-gated Y39/S42 recognition reduces that bias while avoiding buried G41 in 6CU7."},{"sequence":"SNYQPNATQSTKQ","hypothesis":"Polar-led revision of SNYQTNGEQSTDKQ: retain its aromatic/polar character but remove acidic residues and constrain the central linker to address assembly-clash feedback.","expected_discrimination":"The parent showed 10.5/9.5 assembly clashes per residue in 6XYP/6XYQ; require low-clash MSA poses and weaker control contacts, exploiting Y39–S42 distance differences."},{"sequence":"GQNSYTPAQNSTKNSQ","hypothesis":"Polar-led revision of GQNSYTSNQGEDTKNSQ: remove the ED pair and introduce a localized TPA bend to counter the parent's −3.412 contrast.","expected_discrimination":"Seek improved worst-MSA contacts without favoring highly exposed 8A9L; require MSA L38–S42 spacing and T44 access absent together in 6CU7."},{"sequence":"KQSNHYTPAQNSQTNAKSGQTNQS","hypothesis":"Polar-led long alternative based on the 22-residue first-round scaffold: retain His/Tyr and polar extensions, remove acidic residues, and add a Pro-defined bend. No cysteine or hydrophobic run.","expected_discrimination":"The parent remained weak in 6XYP and clashed with 8A9L; test consistent, low-clash MSA engagement of Y39/S42/T44, with geometric rejection of 8A9L and limited T44 access in 6CU7."}]}
